Mod.title: era's Free Camera (test)
Mod.author: \era
Mod.description:
Adds camera rotation and much higher/lower zoom levels.
[list] [*] Holding [b]Left Alt[/b] while dragging your mouse rotates the camera around. [*] Holding [b]Left Ctrl[/b] while dragging your mouse moves the camera in place. [*] Pressing [b]Tilde[/b] moves you between the normal camera and a top-down perspective for easier commanding. [*] Pressing [b]V[/b] resets your camera to the starting, vanilla angle. [*] Pressing [b]Z[/b] or [b]C[/b] rotates the camera. [/list]
Everything is configurable through the Modloader menu or through the camera button when pressing ESC in a mission.
[b]After enabling the mod you must manually quit and re-open the game[/b]. The restart option will not load DLL mods through Modloader.
Code is available here: https://github.com/gabrweu/doorkickers-freecamera
[quote] This mod uses the Door Kickers 2 Mod Loader (dk2ml) to load a DLL running C++ code.
The Modloader is downloadable here: https://github.com/gabrweu/doorkickers-modloader/ Follow install instructions here: https://github.com/gabrweu/doorkickers-modloader/ [/quote]
